decoding.note: Same decoding as the frozen 18-attempt DeepSeek baseline. Only N changes.

workflow: Colab generates up to 20 independent candidates per frozen prompt.
Every candidate is kept, including compile and sim failures.
ecs05 runs the official Xcelium compile and 50us functional simulation.
Evaluation stops at the first functionally passing candidate.
JasperGold CDC/RDC runs only on that first functional-pass RTL.
